name: wh-mods
description: Windhawk mod suite — AudioSwap, MicSwitch, Net-Toggle, MicroManager. C++ Windows internals mods using COM, Win32 Hooks, and Raw Input. Published upstream to ramensoftware/windhawk-mods.
tagline: Toggle audio devices, mute mics, kill network — from the system tray, no bloat.

name: Alternify
description: Live software-alternatives directory with 229+ tools. Dark cyber aesthetic, Cloudflare edge, Google AdSense monetization. Planning Instagram automation pipeline.
tagline: Find open-source alternatives to paid software — no fluff, just direct swaps.

name: WiseLove
description: Premium dating app with slow-reveal mechanics — profile unlocks at message milestones. Merit-only discovery, in-chat date scheduler, gift sticker microtransactions. Next.js 15, Prisma 7.
tagline: Dating where conversation unlocks profiles — not swipes.

name: GestureLock
description: Browser-based hand-tracking game (5,722 lines). MediaPipe Hands, Canvas API, XP/leveling system, Utility AI enemies, particle VFX, delta-time loop. Refactoring to ES6 modules.
tagline: Defend against waves of enemies using hand gestures — no keyboard, no mouse.

name: HellCat
description: High-performance HashCat automation suite for Windows. Streamlines password recovery and cryptographic auditing workflows with batch orchestration and result parsing.
tagline: One-command hash cracking on Windows — batch, watch, collect results.

name: RuView
description: Through-wall spatial intelligence platform. ESP32 CSI firmware (55 C files), 35-crate Rust DSP pipeline (18 µs), Python ML pipeline. Presence, vitals, fall detection, 17-keypoint pose estimation.
tagline: See through walls with WiFi signals — presence, breathing, pose estimation.
